headline: Meta AI now available for DMs on Threads globally
summary: Meta is rolling out its AI chatbot to Threads direct messages worldwide, allowing users to share posts and ask follow-up questions in private conversations.
details: Meta is expanding the availability of Meta AI on Threads, allowing all users worldwide to send direct messages to the AI chatbot starting today. This move aims to provide users with more 'context' from Meta without needing to share their conversations publicly.

Users can now share Threads posts, images, links, or videos directly with Meta AI within a one-on-one conversation. This allows for deeper exploration of topics and follow-up questions, similar to features already available on Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp.
While Meta AI's presence on Threads' public feeds is still in testing in select countries, the DM feature is now globally accessible. Users can interact with the AI by tagging it as @meta.ai.
Although users cannot block the Meta AI account directly, they can opt to mute any replies or select 'not interested' to manage their experience.

headline: AI companies spend record sums on Washington lobbying
summary: The AI industry is making a significant push into influencing US policy, with major players investing heavily in lobbying efforts in Washington D.C. This surge in spending reflects the growing importance of government regulation and public perception for the f
details: Major artificial intelligence companies have dramatically increased their spending on lobbying efforts in Washington D.C., setting new records for the industry. This intensified focus on influencing policy underscores the growing impact of AI on society and the economy.

The substantial investments are directed towards engaging with lawmakers and regulators on critical issues such as AI safety, data privacy, and ethical development. Companies are seeking to shape the narrative and regulatory landscape surrounding artificial intelligence.

This trend highlights the AI sector's recognition of the need for proactive engagement with government bodies. As AI technology continues to advance, the industry appears keen to guide its development and deployment through established political channels.
